cards.card_text: Harps, tambourines, sistrums, cymbals, the WORKS, and Mags, my little bell, would've rung the whole way.
cards.verse_text: David and all the house of Israel were celebrating before the LORD with all kinds of wood instruments, harps, stringed instruments, tambourines, sistrums, and cymbals.
cards.snippet: …with all kinds of wood instruments, harps, stringed instruments, tambourines, sistrums, and cymbals.

cards.card_text: David and all the Israelites are celebrating before God with all their might, with songs, harps, lyres, tambourines, cymbals AND trumpets!
cards.verse_text: David and all the Israelites were celebrating before God with all their might, with songs and on harps and lyres, with tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
cards.snippet: …all their might, with songs and on harps and lyres, with tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.

cards.card_text: Their job comes with harps, lyres and cymbals.
cards.verse_text: David also told the leaders of the Levites to appoint their relatives as singers to lift up their voices with joy, accompanied by musical instruments—harps, lyres, and cymbals.
cards.snippet: …lift up their voices with joy, accompanied by musical instruments—harps, lyres, and cymbals.

cards.card_text: David has the Levite leaders appoint relatives to serve with harps, lyres and cymbals.
cards.verse_text: David also told the leaders of the Levites to appoint their relatives as singers to lift up their voices with joy, accompanied by musical instruments—harps, lyres, and cymbals.
cards.snippet: …lift up their voices with joy, accompanied by musical instruments—harps, lyres, and cymbals.

cards.card_text: Then comes a long list of names: Heman, Asaph and Ethan on bronze cymbals, others on harps and lyres, priests on trumpets, and guardians for the ark.
cards.verse_text: The musicians Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were to sound the bronze cymbals.
cards.snippet: The musicians Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were to sound the bronze cymbals.

cards.card_text: Rams' horns, trumpets, cymbals, harps and lyres, ALL at once.
cards.verse_text: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, with the sounding of rams’ horns and trumpets, and with cymbals and the music of harps and lyres.
cards.snippet: …with shouting, with the sounding of rams’ horns and trumpets, and with cymbals and the music of harps and lyres.

cards.card_text: Asaph, one of the Levite singers (1 Chronicles 15:16-17), is the chief, with a whole crew under him on harps and lyres while he sounds the cymbals.
cards.verse_text: They were to play the harps and lyres, while Asaph sounded the cymbals and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel blew the trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God.
cards.snippet: They were to play the harps and lyres, while Asaph sounded the cymbals and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel blew the trumpets regularly before the…

cards.card_text: With them are Heman, Jeduthun and the rest chosen to give thanks to the LORD, with trumpets and cymbals for the music.
cards.verse_text: With them were Heman, Jeduthun, and the rest of those chosen and designated by name to give thanks to the LORD, for “His loving devotion endures forever.” Heman and Jeduthun had with them trumpets and cymbals for the music and instruments for the songs of God.
cards.snippet: …loving devotion endures forever.” Heman and Jeduthun had with them trumpets and cymbals for the music and instruments for the songs of God.

cards.card_text: The sons play cymbals, harps and lyres under the direction of their fathers.
cards.verse_text: All these were under the direction of their fathers for the music of the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps, and lyres, for the service of the house of God.
cards.snippet: …their fathers for the music of the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps, and lyres, for the service of the house of God.

cards.card_text: The Levitical singers, Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun and their sons and relatives, stand on the east side of the altar in fine linen with cymbals, harps and lyres, and 120 priests with trumpets join them.
cards.verse_text: all the Levitical singers—Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and relatives—stood on the east side of the altar, dressed in fine linen and playing cymbals, harps, and lyres, accompanied by 120 priests sounding trumpets.
cards.snippet: …the east side of the altar, dressed in fine linen and playing cymbals, harps, and lyres, accompanied by 120 priests sounding trumpets.

cards.card_text: These folks lift their voices with trumpets, cymbals and instruments in praise to the LORD: "For He is good; His loving devotion endures forever."
cards.verse_text: They lifted up their voices, accompanied by trumpets, cymbals, and musical instruments, in praise to the LORD: “For He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.” And the temple, the house of the LORD, was filled with a cloud
cards.snippet: They lifted up their voices, accompanied by trumpets, cymbals, and musical instruments, in praise to the LORD: “For He is good;…

cards.card_text: Then Hezekiah stations the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps and lyres, by the command of David, of Gad the king's seer, and of Nathan the prophet.
cards.verse_text: Hezekiah stationed the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps, and lyres according to the command of David, of Gad the king’s seer, and of Nathan the prophet.
cards.snippet: Hezekiah stationed the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps, and lyres according to the command of David, of Gad the…

cards.card_text: The priests in their apparel take their positions with trumpets, and the Levites, the sons of Asaph, come with cymbals.
cards.verse_text: When the builders had laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD, the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites (the sons of Asaph) with cymbals, took their positions to praise the LORD, as David king of Israel had prescribed.
cards.snippet: …their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites (the sons of Asaph) with cymbals, took their positions to praise the LORD, as David king of Israel…

cards.card_text: At the new temple foundation, the priests with trumpets and the Levites with cymbals take their positions.
cards.verse_text: When the builders had laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD, the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites (the sons of Asaph) with cymbals, took their positions to praise the LORD, as David king of Israel had prescribed.
cards.snippet: …their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites (the sons of Asaph) with cymbals, took their positions to praise the LORD, as David king of Israel…

cards.card_text: Thanksgiving songs with cymbals and harps Victory shouts with drums and flutes Dancing songs with tambourines and pipes
cards.verse_text: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, the Levites were sought out from all their homes and brought to Jerusalem to celebrate the joyous dedication with thanksgiving and singing, accompanied by cymbals, harps, and lyres.
cards.snippet: …Jerusalem to celebrate the joyous dedication with thanksgiving and singing, accompanied by cymbals, harps, and lyres.

cards.card_text: Then the psalm says, "Praise Him with clashing cymbals; praise Him with resounding cymbals." Two kinds of cymbals, friend, and I can't even keep track of two oven mitts.
cards.verse_text: Praise Him with clashing cymbals; praise Him with resounding cymbals.
cards.snippet: Praise Him with clashing cymbals; praise Him with resounding cymbals.

cards.card_text: With clashing cymbals and resounding cymbals, the praise in Psalm 150 is ___.
cards.verse_text: Praise Him with clashing cymbals; praise Him with resounding cymbals.
cards.snippet: Praise Him with clashing cymbals; praise Him with resounding cymbals.

cards.card_text: A ringing gong or a clanging cymbal A lamp without any oil A cloud without any rain
cards.verse_text: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am only a ringing gong or a clanging cymbal.
cards.snippet: …have not love, I am only a ringing gong or a clanging cymbal.
